title: Weekly report digest by email
summary: The week's records sent by your reporting system are counted and totalled for the stated week and emailed as a short digest; a week with no activity says so.

requirements.purpose: A weekly schedule or webhook that delivers {period: {start, end}, recipient, records: [{date, type, amount}]}.

success_criteria: Counts and totals include exactly the records dated inside the stated week and match them.
The email names the week and the recipient, and contains no activity that is not in the records.
A week with no records produces an explicit no-activity digest.

config.prompt: The upstream output holds a reporting period (start and end dates, both inclusive), a recipient email address and a list of records with date, type and amount. Use only records dated from start to end inclusive; ignore the rest and say how many were ignored. Count records by type and total their amounts by type, to two decimals. Respond with {"included": number of records used, "ignored": number outside the period, "by_type": {type: {"count": n, "total": amount}}, "to": the recipient, "subject": "Weekly digest <start> to <end>", "body": a plain-text digest naming the period and listing each type's count and total, or stating that there was no activity in the period}. Never add records, types or figures that are not in the input.

success_criteria: Only records dated inside the period are counted, and every count and total is arithmetically correct.
The body names the period and invents no activity; an empty period is reported as no activity.

test_cases.name: populated week with one record outside it
success_criteria: The digest counts 2 orders totalling 2000.00 and 1 refund totalling 150.00, and ignores the 2026-10-05 record.
It is addressed to owner@example.com and names the period 2026-09-28 to 2026-10-04.

test_cases.name: empty week reports no activity
success_criteria: The digest states there was no activity from 2026-09-21 to 2026-09-27.
It reports no counts or totals other than zero.
